AI Video Maker for Marketing v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly turn product images and a logo into polished 1080p marketing videos using simple text instructions.
- Fast setup: Anonymous sessions available with free trial credits; automatic token management included.
- Cloud rendering: Upload up to 500MB of images or clips, describe your desired video, and export MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Comprehensive workflow support: Edit, preview, check credits, and export from a single interface.
- Smart API routing: User prompts automatically mapped to upload, video edit, export, and account actions.
- Helpful troubleshooting: Clear feedback for common errors like file size, credits, and unsupported formats.
